title: Supabase persistence, CRUD, schema ownership audit and database integration

steps.title: College Admin Authentication
steps.description: College Administrator authenticates via development test session and opens the Course Registration Desk

steps.title: Verify Enrolment Desk Loaded
steps.description: College enrolment desk renders — UI path to Java enrolment service backed by PostgresEnrollmentPersistence

steps.title: Select Academic Term
steps.description: Registrar selects the existing 2026 ODD academic term so catalogue/CRUD reads use live JDBC

steps.title: Confirm Term Bound
steps.description: UI confirms the academic term is selected for persistence-scoped operations

steps.title: PostgreSQL Enrolment Row Read-Back
steps.description: Read-only query proves stu.enrolments CRUD data exists for the pilot tenant via Supabase PostgreSQL
steps.query: SELECT id, status, student_id, term_id FROM stu.enrolments WHERE tenant_id = 'a0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001' AND id = 'a1000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000031'

steps.title: Schema Ownership / RLS Audit
steps.description: Verify STM-03 enrolment tables have RLS enabled and FORCED under stu schema (service-owned model)
steps.query: SELECT c.relname AS table_name FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname = 'stu' AND c.relkind = 'r' AND c.relname LIKE 'enrol%' AND c.relrowsecurity = true AND c.relforcerowsecurity = true

steps.title: Negative RBAC — Unauthenticated Gateway Blocked
steps.description: API Gateway blocks unauthenticated GET to enrolment list with HTTP 401
